bio_en: Babken Siuni, real name Petros Parian, was born in the 1870s into a poor family of the village of Pinkian near Akn and went to Constantinople as a child. He entered the Central school in 1887 and graduated, though he was jailed for six months while a student for helping a fugitive comrade; after a year at sea he entered the naval school at Azap Kapu, hoping to serve the revolution as a ship's captain. He conceived and organised the seizure of the Ottoman Bank in August 1896 and was its first casualty. Simon Vratsian called his death a great loss not only for Constantinople but for the whole ARF.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
